description: KULIC Advisory, AICTIONBOT™ Workbench. Changes a Shared Table from its full link (including the part after #): edit the text of entries or remove them by their id from read_table, draw or remove lines between two cards on the free board, and rename the table. A removed entry stays removed for both sides. Only change what the user asked for; the other side sees the change in the browser within a few seconds.

author.description: Name shown with new lines. Default: AICTIONBOT™ Connector.

connect.description: Lines to draw between two entries on the free board.

disconnect.description: Lines to remove, by their two entries.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

link.description: The full table link including the part after #.

name: change_table
title: Change a Shared Table: edit or remove entries, connect cards on the board, rename
